display.summary: SECURITY (high priority): stored files were served without authorization. 1.15.3 makes them private; after updating, run ./start.sh check --fix (Composer 1.9.2+) so the proxy asks DjangoLux before serving them.
highlights: SECURITY: the generated proxy served every /media/ file to anyone, without signing in. Stored files are now private by default (stack schema 4).
Only media/public/, branding and managed images and fonts stay public; every other stored file is checked by the app first.
A registered document's file reaches only users who may view that document; backups, protected assets and file history are never served from /media/.
Updating DjangoLux alone does not change your proxy: run ./start.sh check --fix with Composer 1.9.2+, or copy the new /media/ blocks by hand.
List folders your site shows to signed-out visitors in DLUX_PUBLIC_MEDIA (or move them under media/public/) before switching.
